1: And it hath come to pass afterwards, I do pour out My Spirit on all flesh, And prophesied have your sons and your daughters, Your old men do dream dreams, Your young men do see visions.
2: And also on the men-servants, and on the maid-servants, In those days I do pour out My Spirit.
3: And I have given wonders in the heavens, and in the earth, Blood and fire, and columns of smoke.
4: The sun is turned to darkness, and the moon to blood, Before the coming of the day of Jehovah, The great and the fearful.
5: And it hath come to pass, Every one who calleth in the name of Jehovah is delivered, For in mount Zion and in Jerusalem there is an escape, As Jehovah hath said, And among the remnants whom Jehovah is calling!
